Common questions

Before you hand off a matter.

Plain answers for firms weighing outside support.

Is Monroy's Paralegal Services a law firm?

No. Monroy's Paralegal Services does not provide legal advice or independently represent clients. All paralegal work is performed under the supervision of a licensed attorney. See the full disclaimer below.

Who supervises the work?

Your firm does. The licensed attorney responsible for the matter sets the scope, provides direction, and reviews and approves all final work.

How is confidentiality handled?

Work follows your firm's approved systems and access controls. An NDA can be signed on request. Final security and document-handling procedures will be confirmed in the engagement letter.

What are typical turnaround times?

TBD — to be confirmed with Maria. Each deadline will be discussed at intake and agreed before work begins.

How do we start?

Share the type of matter, work needed, deadline, and your preferred systems. The next steps are a conflict check, a written engagement, and secure onboarding.

What does it cost?

Possible engagement models include hourly support, per-project work, and an overflow retainer. Final rate card and minimums are coming soon.
